# Security policy

Report security vulnerabilities affecting Phoenix or Phoenix-operated infrastructure through
[GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/goodbirdhq/phoenix/security/advisories/new)
on this repository. Please do not disclose them publicly until we have had a reasonable
opportunity to investigate and remediate them.

This is an unofficial fork of [T3 Code](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code). Vulnerabilities in
upstream T3 Code or T3 Tools-operated infrastructure belong to
[T3 Code's own security policy](https://t3.codes/security-policy), not this repository.
